payload.headline: Tech (QQQ) in a downtrend, broad market (SPY) sideways, fear elevated.

verdict.text: 2 setups triggered today; none is eligible to act on. QQQ is below its 50-day average ($719.20): the short-term trend is down. Fear is elevated (VIX 20.6). No setup is approved: 3 live setups are blocked, most often by "QQQ is not above its 50-day average". Nothing has a proven edge, so the default is no action. Next decision points: CPI Nov 10 08:30; PPI Nov 13 08:30; NVDA earnings Nov 17.
